summary: Core invariants established for SchemaTOUCHER: (1) last registered schema = default working schema on spine open; (2) every entry references its exact schema ID@version; (3) Browse renders each entry under its own recorded schema, independent of the Entry Form active schema.
decision_or_outcome: These invariants are non-negotiable and must be preserved across all changes. The three-tab UI (Entry Form / Schema Editor / Browse Entries) is settled and must not be redesigned.
